entities.summary: Luis Humberto Delgado Aparicio Porta was a Peruvian politician. He served in the Congress of the Republic of Peru from 1995 to 2001. Before serving as a congressman, Aparicio was a delegate from 1990 through 1992. He was born in Callao, Peru.
